logic: 1. Determine the effective timestamp: use parameters.asOfTimestamp if supplied, otherwise the current system timestamp. 2. Build a query condition on the UomConversionDated entity: (thruDate is null OR thruDate >= asOfTimestamp) AND uomId equals parameters.uomId AND uomIdTo equals parameters.uomIdTo AND fromDate <= asOfTimestamp. If parameters.purposeEnumId is present, add an additional equality on purposeEnumId. 3. Execute the query, ordering results by fromDate descending and applying filterByDate to keep only rows valid for the asOfTimestamp. 4. If at least one rate row is returned, take the first row, read its conversionFactor (BigDecimal). 5. Compute conversionRate = 1 ÷ conversionFactor, rounding to 2 decimal places with RoundingMode.HALF_UP. 6. Return a map that contains the key 'conversionRate' with the calculated value; on failure return an error map.
